name: Protein pancake mix, dry
identity: Dry protein pancake mix, 39 to 72 g protein per 100 g of powder before milk or water is added.
rule: Per 100 g, each value is the median of the three labels below that declare it, and a value enters only when at least three labels declare it (plain or default flavour). Salt becomes sodium (salt in g × 400 = sodium in mg). Nothing a label leaves out becomes zero. Labels read on 2026-10-30 from Open Food Facts through Akari's proxy, as the beef protein isolate was.

labels.ingredients: protéine de lait (44%), farine d'avoine, blanc d'oeuf de poule en poudre (10%), œuf entier en poudre (2,5%), édulcorant: xylitol, glucosides de stéviol issus de stevia; acidifiant acide citrique, poudre à lever: carbonates de sodium, vanilline
Whey protein isolate, gluten free oat flour, buttermilk powder, flax seed powder, natural flavors, baking powder, salt, baking soda, xanthan gum, stevia.
